people.doc: The citizens themselves: ages and lives, households and names, needs, health and happiness, services they use, status icons, immigration and burial.

behaviour.doc: How characters act: the citizen AI and its activities, the agents that run citizens and animals, characters and their action stacks, animation and commuting.

work.doc: The work economy: jobs and professions, construction and demolition, production recipes, stock and storage, building controls, trackers and roads.

production.doc: Workplaces that gather or grow resources: quarries and mines, foresters, herbalists, hunters, fishing docks, crop fields, orchards and pastures.

commerce.doc: Trade: markets, the trading post and the trader boats.

nature.doc: The natural world: resource seeding and spawning, growth, wildlife and the climate.

world.doc: The map: its cells, floors (bridges), building placement and terraforming.

disasters.doc: Disasters: fire, crop blight and tornadoes.
